answer: The sable counter is kept in vault and nebula publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 378 aliases cost 172 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
